description: This file defines a PHP class WorkflowStateModel which represents a model for workflow states in the OrangeHRM system. It implements serialization into an array and appears to be used for API responses related to workflow states.

classes.name: WorkflowStateModel
classes.description: A model class representing workflow state data for API serialization, encapsulating a WorkflowStateMachine entity.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with a WorkflowStateMachine entity.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the model into an associative array suitable for API responses, including 'action' and 'name' properties.
